answer.decision: Use field-specific merge rules with monotonic status precedence and version metadata.
answer.action: Merge profile fields automatically using deterministic per-field version metadata and unique operation IDs. For account status, make suspended dominate active and permit reactivation only through an explicit reviewed unsuspend operation. Test convergence, replay/idempotency, partition recovery, and authorization invariants.
reasons: Last-write-wins based on wall-clock time is unsafe because observed regional clock skew has reached 47 seconds.
Monotonic status precedence prevents stale replicated data from changing suspended accounts back to active.
Field-specific merging allows rare profile conflicts to converge automatically without sacrificing authorization safety.
Unique operation IDs already provide a basis for deduplication, replay handling, and deterministic reconciliation.
Keeping both regions writable satisfies the stated business-continuity requirement during partitions.
The resolver can identify reviewed unsuspend operations, allowing a controlled exception to status monotonicity.
assumptions: Version metadata can provide deterministic ordering or causal context without relying solely on wall-clock timestamps.
Reviewed unsuspend operations are authenticated, auditable, and distinguishable from stale active-state replication.
The requirement to remain writable applies to profile updates; sensitive status transitions may use stricter controls.
risks: Incorrect implementation of status precedence or unsuspend detection could create an authorization vulnerability.
Concurrent profile edits to the same field still require a deterministic tie-breaker and may select an undesirable value.
Version metadata growth, compaction, or migration could complicate operations.
A reviewed unsuspend concurrent with a newer suspension must be defined so suspension remains dominant unless the review explicitly covers it.

citations.claim: Suspended status must dominate stale active data, with reactivation allowed only through an explicit reviewed unsuspend operation.
Regional clock skew has reached 47 seconds, making wall-clock last-write-wins unsafe.
Profile conflicts are rare and should converge automatically.
Both regions already attach unique operation IDs to writes.
Both regions must remain able to accept profile updates during partitions lasting up to one hour.
